content.content:
OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
=== addOwner op 65-100 ===
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:

content.text:
The build is green. Here's what I implemented to satisfy the specification.

## Summary

The endpoint `POST /api/owners` (handled by `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`) now rejects owners missing or blank in any of `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, or `telephone`, returning **400** with a JSON body whose `errors` array lists each offending field name.

The generated `OwnerFieldsDto` already carries Bean Validation (`@Valid` on the request body), but it had two gaps for this spec: the 400 response had no `errors` array, and whitespace-only `address`/`city` slipped past the `@Size(min=1)` constraint. I addressed both:

**1. `ExceptionControllerAdvice.java`**
- The existing `MethodArgumentNotValidException` handler (fires for `null` fields and pattern violations like a blank `telephone`) now also sets an `errors` property — the distinct list of rejected field names.
- Added a handler for a new `InvalidRequestException` that returns 400 with the same `errors` array, for blank-field cases Bean Validation doesn't express.

**2. `InvalidRequestException.java`** (new) — a small exception carrying the list of offending field names.

**3. `OwnerRestControllerV1.java`**
- `addOwner` now calls `validateRequiredFields(...)` first, which collects every field that is null or blank (`isBlank` = null or whitespace-only) and throws `InvalidRequestException` listing them all. This catches whitespace-only `address`/`city` that the generated `@Size` constraint misses, and keeps the response shape consistent.

## Verification
- `AcceptanceTest`: missing-city → 400 with `errors` containing `"city"`; blank telephone → 400; complete owner → 2xx. All pass.
- Full suite: **BUILD SUCCESS**, Tests run: 3, Failures: 0, Errors: 0.
